content.thinking: Guards: need distinct increasing integers g with 0 <= 2g < S. So g in [0, floor((S-1)/2)]. Population size = (S-1)//2 + 1. rng.sample needs enough. Fix: `ng = rng.randint(1,2); pop = list(range((S-1)//2+1)); guards = sorted(rng.sample(pop, min(ng, len(pop))))`. Also ensure non-empty.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
src=open('test_plan.py').read()
src=src.replace("    guards=sorted(rng.sample(range(0, max(1,S//2)), rng.randint(1,2)))",
"""    pop=list(range((S-1)//2+1))
    guards=sorted(rng.sample(pop, min(rng.randint(1,2), len(pop))))""")
open('test_plan.py','w').write(src)
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 1800 python3 test_plan.py
